# Events

<!-- Generated by `npm run events:doc -w @club/server` from apps/server/src/data/event-types.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every event the platform records, written with `emit()` into the `events` table (spec §14.2).

- `props` values are a number, boolean, null, or a code matching `^[A-Za-z0-9_:.\-]{1,64}$`. Free text goes in `raw`.
- An event that does not match its declaration throws in tests and goes to `events_dead_letter` in production.
- Privacy classes: `none` (a code or count), `pseudonymous` (an id that links to a person or record), `personal` (identifies a person; `raw` only).

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `guest.first_seen` | 1 | — | personal | First message or follow from a guest the club has not seen. |
| `guest.followed` | 1 | — | personal | Guest added the club OA. |
| `guest.unfollowed` | 1 | — | — | Guest blocked or removed the club OA. |
| `guest.refollowed` | 1 | — | personal | Guest who unfollowed added the OA again. |
| `notice.shown` | 1 | `notice_id` (pseudonymous), `purpose` (none), `text_version` (none) | — | Data notice shown to the guest (spec §5.5). |
| `notice.accepted` | 1 | `notice_id` (pseudonymous), `purpose` (none), `text_version` (none) | — | Guest accepted the notice in the booking form. |
| `marketing.opted_out` | 1 | — | personal | Guest asked for no marketing. |
